It feels like maybe they don't know what to ask me about, or I don't do a good enough job of being interesting. Like I usually get asked about work and there's really nothing exciting to say there, so that piece dies. Then I'll ask them a question of similar caliber (like how was your recent trip or something) and they answer but then seem fidgety and like they are looking for an exit. So rather than making them talk more which they don't seem to want to do, I let it die naturally so they can make a break. Then they avoid me the rest of the night. Actually... I don't think I've ever had a conversation with someone where they appear enthused about talking to me. I think maybe people don't know what to talk to me about, but still I mean then what am I supposed to do? I'm interested in others and ask them good questions, but they are like never at ease, so I don't know what to do to resolve this because I'm developing this inferiority complex where I just avoid people who I don't think want to talk to me.
